reviews.comment: Professor Smith is very kind! She makes lectures very interesting, and her grading policy is very easy. There are only 2 tests throughout the semester: the midterm and final, and they are both only worth 15% each! All the daily quizzes are open notes and open to discussion with classmates!

Hand down the best professor I've had at TAMU. Lectures were super interesting and she was great at keeping people engaged whilst teaching the material. I learned a ton in this class despite it being a pretty easy course.

Great professor and super interesting content! Attendance was not mandatory to get an A and only 30% of the grade is based on tests which we are allowed a prepared sheet of paper for. If you study the content the tests are easy.
Dr. Smith is just amazing. She is kind, understanding, and super passionate about her job. Also not to mention crazy smart. I 100% recommend her!!

Very good, knowledgeable professor. The class is very interesting and rather easy! She let's you use a cheat sheet of your creation on exams. There's group work and quizzes at the end of every class, but you can do them on your own if you choose to. I loved her!

This class was so fun if you have any interest in astronomy! Almost all of the grades were completed and there were many opportunities to improve your grade. Additionally, the tests were manageable since we were allowed a sheet of paper front and back on the test! Professor Smith is awesome, and I finished the class with a 101.

She is amazing and you can tell she really loves what she teaches! There are 3 assignments a week, midterm and final. You do have to purchase Packback and Pearson because of online quizzes but all her work is open internet and group work so very easy to pass her class!

Great class you should take this for a science credit. Your overall grade will mainly be doing packbacks and weekly quizzes that can be done with a group in class or outside of class. Attendance is optional all the lectures are posted online but if you go to lecture the material is a lot more straightforward. Front and back cheat sheet for 2 tests.

Prof Smith is amazing she is so sweet and entertaining in class. Going to lectures is important to understand the material but if you miss its not a huge deal because she posts the slides which is a good synopsis of the concepts covered. Every class their is either a quiz or activity due at midnight that can be done in groups. Definitley take her!!

Professor Smith really cares about the class. You can see how passionate she is about astronomy, and she makes the class interesting. There are weekly packbacks and quizzes in every class that you can work on together with other people. The mid-term is very straightforward as long as you pay attention or look at the lesson slides. Highly recommend.

She's very kind and accommodating, and her lectures are interesting. You're allowed to have a cheat sheet for exams, and she has extra credit opportunities for exams. A lot of your grade comes just from participation. Great class to take for a life and physical science credit.

AMAZING! Her lectures are very engaging. Prof smith is very well knowledgeable on this subject which makes her lectures amazing. There is some math that is a little difficult but overall she is very helpful and an amazing professor She assigns homework which is based on the lectures If you have the opportunity to take a class with her DO IT.

Attendance on Fridays are basically mandatory since the in-class activities count for ~30% of the overall grade. Very accessible at her office hours, and amazing at explaining concepts. Taking her class right now and breezing through with an A.
2 Mid terms, finals count for 10% each; relatively decent difficulty. Know your stuff and 95+ is easy.

Dr. Smith is easy to listen to during lectures and does a great job at making the class interesting. The work load outside of class is not very heavy, and you have ample opportunity to bump your grade with the homework assignments. Exams are are low percentage of your average grade and she lets you bring a handwritten notecard to use.
